issues.description: Stock method name mismatch: The problem statement/UML requires a method named Stock.addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient), but the template repository defines the corresponding method as addItem(StockIngredient). Students implementing SealSaloon.acceptSupplyDelivery as specified (and as in the reference solution) will look for/addToStockIngredients and cannot use the provided template method without renaming or adding a wrapper.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename template method Stock.addItem(StockIngredient) to addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient), or add a public addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient) wrapper delegating to addItem, so the template matches the UML/spec and reference solution.

issues.description: Contradiction about whether SealSaloon.stock is static: The text explicitly requires the 'stock' attribute to be static (shared across all SealSaloon instances), but the UML association presents 'stock' as an instance attribute (non-static association from SealSaloon to Stock). This can mislead students about whether to implement stock per instance or as a shared static field.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the UML explicitly mark stock as static (e.g., underline it or add {static}) to match the written requirement, or adjust the written requirement if stock is intended to be per-instance.
